title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
authors: C. Raffel, N. Shazeer, A. Roberts, K. Lee, S. Narang, et al. (9 authors)
before: Each task had its own output head, loss and evaluation convention.
problem: Incompatible task formats made it impossible to compare methods or share one model.
breakthrough: Cast every task as text in, text out, and run a controlled comparison of objectives, data and scale across them.
why: It unified the task interface, which is the conceptual step that makes instruction following possible.
next: FLAN instruction-tuned T5 models; the text-to-text framing became universal.
inherits: Everything as a text task, the assumption behind prompting.
